text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess was convinced that it 
was her fault Sweep Tosho's classmate had 
decided to give up on racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when we were running side-by-side, I 
got stubborn, clashed, and bumped into 
her. I don't... want to cause trouble for 
anyone ever again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It had practically become a source of 
trauma for her. However, Sweep Tosho gave 
even that Kawakami Princess a stern 
talking-to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is prepared for the dangers that 
come with racing. She resolves to remind 
Kawakami Princess of what is truly 
important when stepping onto the track!
